2.en: 1. Philosophical Encyclopedia for the Senior Class 1)
2.zh: 1. 供高年级用的哲学百科全书 1)

en: An encyclopedia has to consider the entire range of the sciences in accordance with the object of each of them and with their fundamental concept.
zh: 一部百科全书应当按照每一门科学的对象、按照它们的基本概念，来考察科学的全部范围。

en: The multiplicity of experiences about a general object, brought together into the unity of general representations, and the thoughts generated in the consideration of its essence make up in their interconnection a particular science.
zh: 关于一个一般对象的种种经验，归结为一般表象的统一，再加上在考察它的本质时产生出来的思想，这二者在相互关联中构成一门特殊的科学。

en: If this interconnection rests on an empirical material, of which it forms only a summarizing generality, then the science is more of a historical kind; but if the universal goes before in the form of fundamental determinations and concepts, and the particular is to be derived from the same, then the science is more properly scientific in kind.
zh: 如果这种关联以经验材料为基础，而它对这种材料只构成一个加以概括的普遍性，那么这门科学就更多属于历史的性质；但如果普遍者以基本规定和概念的形式走在前面，而特殊者应当从同一个来源推出来，那么这门科学就更真正是科学的性质。

en: There are no absolute limits to a range of knowledges which is to constitute the particular of a science, for every general or concrete object can be divided into its species or parts, and each such species can again be considered as the object of a particular science.
zh: 对于应当构成某一门科学之特殊内容的认识范围来说，并不存在绝对的界限；因为每一个一般或具体的对象都可以分成它的种或部分，而每一个这样的种又可以看作某一门特殊科学的对象。

en: In an ordinary encyclopedia the sciences are taken up empirically, just as they are to be found.
They are to be listed there completely and, further, brought into an order in that the similar and what coincides under common determinations is assembled according to an analogous affinity.
zh: 在一部普通的百科全书里，各门科学是按照它们现成的样子、经验地被收进来的。
它们应当在其中被完整地列举出来，并且进一步获得一种秩序：相似的、在共同规定下相遇的东西，按一种类似的亲缘关系被排列在一起。

en: The philosophical encyclopedia, however, is the science of the necessary interconnection determined through the concept and of the philosophical origination of the fundamental concepts and principles of the sciences.
zh: 但哲学百科全书是一门关于如下两者的科学：由概念所规定的必然关联，以及各门科学的基本概念和基本原理在哲学上的产生。

en: It is properly the presentation of the general content of philosophy, for what in the sciences is founded on reason depends on philosophy; what on the contrary in them rests on arbitrary and external determinations, or, as it is called, is positive and statutory, as well as the merely empirical, lies outside it.
zh: 它其实是对哲学一般内容的阐述，因为在诸门科学中以理性为基础的东西依赖于哲学；相反，在它们那里建立在任意的和外在的规定之上的东西，或者说，按人们所讲的、实证而依法定的的东西，以及纯粹经验的东西，都处在它之外。

en: According to their mode of knowing, the sciences are either empirical or purely rational.
Considered in the absolute, both are to have the same content.
It is the goal of scientific striving to sublate what is merely empirically known into the always true and into the concept, to make it rational, and thereby to incorporate it into rational science.
zh: 各门科学按其认识方式而言，要么是经验的，要么是纯粹理性的。
就绝对方面来看，两者应当有同样的内容。
把纯粹在经验中所知的东西扬弃到那永远为真的东西里、扬弃到概念里，使它成为理性的，并由此把它纳入理性的科学——这就是科学追求的目标。

en: The sciences expand partly in the empirical, partly in the rational direction.
The latter happens in that the essential is more and more lifted out, taken up under general points of view, and the merely empirical is comprehended in the concept.
The rational expansion of the sciences is at the same time an expansion of philosophy itself.
zh: 各门科学一部分向经验的方向扩展，一部分向理性的方向扩展。
后一种情形是这样发生的：把本质性的东西越来越多地提出来，在一般观点之下加以把握，并把纯粹经验的东西纳入概念来把握。
诸科学的理性扩展同时也就是哲学本身的扩展。

en: The whole of science divides into three main parts: logic, 2. the science of nature, 3. the science of spirit. – Logic is namely the science of the pure concepts and of the abstract idea.
Nature and spirit make up the reality of the idea, the former as external determinate being, the latter as knowing itself.
(Or the logical is the eternally simple essence in itself; nature is this essence as externalized; spirit the return of the same into itself from its externalization.)
zh: 科学的整体分成三个主要部分：逻辑学，2. 自然科学，3. 精神科学。——逻辑学其实就是纯粹概念和抽象观念的科学。
自然与精神构成观念的实在性，前者是外在的定在，后者是自知的存在。
（或者说，逻辑者就是本身永恒而简单的本质；自然就是这个本质的外化；精神是这个本质从外化中返回自身。）

en: The sciences of nature and of spirit may be regarded as the applied science, as the system of the real or particular sciences, in contrast to the pure science or logic, because they are the system of the pure science in the shape of nature and of spirit.
zh: 自然和精神的科学可以被看作被应用的科学，可以被看作实在的或特殊的科学的体系，以与纯粹的科学即逻辑学相区别，因为它们就是纯粹科学的体系，采取了自然和精神的形态。

en: Logic is the science of pure understanding and pure reason, of their own determinacies and laws.
The logical has accordingly three sides: 1. the abstract or understanding-like, 2. the dialectical or negatively rational, 3. the speculative or positively rational.

The understanding-like stays with the concepts in their fixed determinacy and their determinateness from others; the dialectical shows them up in their passing over and their dissolution; the speculative or rational comprehends their unity in their oppositeness, or the positive in the dissolution and in the passing over.
zh: 逻辑学是纯粹知性和纯粹理性的科学，是它们特有的规定与法则的科学。
因此逻辑的东西有三个侧面：1. 抽象的或知性的，2. 辩证的或否定理性的，3. 思辨的或肯定理性的。
知性的东西停留在概念上，停留在它们固定的規定性以及它们与其他概念的差别上；辩证的东西在它们过渡和消解的时候把它们显示出来；思辨的东西即理性的东西，在它们的对立中把握它们的统一，或者在消解和过渡中把握肯定的东西。

en: Understanding and reason are here usually taken in the subjective sense, in so far as they belong, as thinking, to a self-consciousness, and logic is accordingly a merely formal science, which first requires a content of its own, an external stuff, if something truly true is to come about.
zh: 这里的知性和理性通常是就主观的意义而言，就它们作为思维属于一个自我意识而言；因此逻辑学就是一门纯粹形式的科学，只有当某种真正真理的东西要产生出来的时候，它才需要另外的内容、一份外在的材料。

en: As for its content, logic considers understanding and reason in and for themselves and the absolute concepts as the in-and-for-itself true ground of everything, or as the understanding-like and the rational, in so far as this is not merely a conscious comprehending.

Logic is therefore in itself speculative philosophy, for the speculative way of considering things is nothing other than the consideration of the essence of things, and this essence is just as much a pure concept, proper to reason, as nature and the law of things are.
zh: 就内容而言，逻辑学考察的是自在自为的知性和理性，是绝对概念，把它们看作一切事物自在自为的真正根据，或者说看作知性的和理性的东西，只要这并不是一种单纯有意识的以概念把握。
因此逻辑学本身自在地就是思辨哲学，因为对事物的思辨观看方式无非是观看事物的本质，而这个本质正如自然和事物的法则一样，是纯粹的概念，是理性所特有的。

en: Logic falls into three parts: 1. into the ontological, 2. into subjective logic, 3. into the doctrine of ideas.
The first is the system of the pure concepts of the existing, the second that of the pure concepts of the universal, the third contains the concept of science.
zh: 逻辑学分成三个部分：1. 本体逻辑学，2. 主观逻辑学，3. 观念论。
第一部分是存在者的纯粹概念的体系，第二部分是普遍者的纯粹概念的体系，第三部分包含科学的概念。

36.zh: 第一节 本体逻辑学

en: a. Being
zh: a. 存在

en: The beginning of science is the immediate concept of being without determinacy. – 2.
This concept is, in its lack of content, as much as nothing.
Nothing, as the thinking of that emptiness, is thus conversely itself a being, and on account of its purity the same as that being. – 3.
There is therefore no difference between them, but what is, is hereby only the positing of them as different and the vanishing of each in its opposite, or it is pure becoming.
zh: 科学的开端是存在的直接而无规定性的概念。——2.
这个概念由于没有内容，就等于无。
无，作为对那种空无的思维，反过来本身也是一种存在，而且由于它的纯粹，它与那个存在是同一个东西。——3.
所以这两者之间并没有差别，而是：现在有的，只是把它们设定为彼此有别，以及每一个在它的对立物中的消失，或者说，它就是纯粹的生成。

en: b. Determinate Being
zh: b. 定在

en: But since in becoming those determinations posited earlier merely disappear, becoming is their falling-together into a quiet simplicity in which they are not nothing, but also no longer each for itself, but are moments as sublated.
This unity is determinate being.
zh: 但因为在生成中，先前设定的那些规定只是消失了，所以生成就是它们一同落入一种平静的简单性，在这种简单性里它们不是无，却也不再各自自在，而是作为被扬弃的东西、作为环节。
这一统一就是定在。

en: Determinate being is 1. a being in whose concept the non-being of it as relation to Other, or being-for-Other, lies at the same time; 2. but, according to the moment of being, it has the side not of being related to Other, but of being in itself.
As the concept which holds both these determinations within itself, it is reality.
zh: 定在是：1. 一个存在，在它的概念里同时包含着它作为对他物之关系的非存在，或者说，包含着为他的存在；2. 但是按照存在的环节来看，它有这样一个侧面：不是与他物相关，而是自在存在。
作为把这两个规定收在自身之内的概念，它就是实在性。

en: The real element or Something is, as different from another real something, initially indifferent towards it, since in its otherness it is at the same time in itself.
The difference of such things is initially in the limit as the midpoint between them, in which they are as much as they are not.
zh: 实在物，或者说某物，与别的实在物相区别时，起初对它无所谓，因为在自己的他在中它同时是自在的。
这类东西的差异最初在于界限，界限就是它们之间的中项，在界限里它们既在又不在。

en: They are 1. different from the limit or from their difference, which is their midpoint, outside of which they are something.
But 2. the limit belongs to them themselves, because it is their limit.
zh: 它们是：1. 区别于界限，或区别于它们的那一差异——界限是它们的中项，在界限之外它们才是某物。
但是，2. 界限属于它们自身，因为它是它们的界限。

en: Difference is thus 1. the proper difference of the real element or its determinacy.
This determinacy being-in-itself is however also 2. external determinate being or quality.
The determinacy which is both external and internal constitutes quality.
zh: 差异于是就是：1. 实在物自身的差异，或者说是它的规定性。
这个自在的规定性但同时又是：2. 外在的定在，或者说属性。
既是外在又是内在的规定性，构成了质。

en: c. Change
zh: c. 变化

en: The quality or external determinate being belongs to the Something as far as it is alien to it, or is its otherness, and so its non-being.
It is thus the inequality of the Something with itself by which change is posited.
zh: 属性，或者说外在的定在，属于某物，因为它对某物来说是异己的，是它的他在，因而是它的非存在。
所以，某物与自身的不相等，就是变化得以被设定的东西。

en: Since change is the negating of the negative which the Something has in itself, being-for-itself has arisen.
Or the determinacy, as the internal difference which the Something has in itself, is the relation of the Something in its difference only to itself, or it is for itself.
zh: 由于变化是对某物自身所带的那个否定物的否定，自为存在便产生了。
或者说，规定性作为某物自身具有的内在差异，就是某物在其区别中只同自身的关系，或者说，它是自为的。

en: a. Being-for-itself (ideality)
zh: a. 自为存在（观念性）

en: Being-for-itself is 1. the difference, but only of itself, or the relation, not to something Other but to itself.
Insofar however as the difference contains otherness in itself and the relation to it is negative, something Other is for it, but as excluded.
zh: 自为存在是：1. 区别，但只是与自身的区别，或者说是一种关系：不是指向他物，而是指向自身。
但就区别本身包含着他在、并且指向他的关系是否定的而言，他物对它说来是存在的，但作为被排除者。

en: The being-for-itself is numerical One.
It is simple, refers only to itself, and excludes the Other from it.
Its being-other is the multiplicity.
zh: 自为存在着的（东西）就是数的一。
它是单一的，只关联自身，并把他者从自身排除出去。
它的他在就是众多。

en: The many are each the same.
They are therefore One.
But the One is just as much the multiplicity.
For its exclusion is the positing of its opposite, or thereby it posits itself as multiplicity.
That becoming is the attraction, this the repulsion.
zh: 众多者每一个都是同一个。
所以它们是一。
但这一同样就是众多。
因为它的排除就是设定它的对立面，或者说，它由此把自己设定为众多。
那个生成是吸引，这个生成是排斥。

en: Since one becoming is posited as much as the other, their truth is the rest, which is just as much the being-outside of the One, or its positing of itself as multiplicity, as discreteness, namely the relation of the many to themselves that is equal to itself, or as their continuity, that is the pure quantity.
zh: 既然一个生成被设定得和另一个一样多，它们的真理就是那静止，它既是一的在外存在，或者它把自己设定为众多、离散，也就是众多者与自身等同的相互关系，或者它们的连续性，它就是纯粹量。

en: b. Quantum
zh: b. 量数

en: Quantity has the negativity of the One in it only as sublated, or because in the self-sameness of being-for-itself the being-other is immediately nothing other than an external limit, or a limit that is no limit.
Quantity with this indifferent limit is quantum.
zh: 量只有在自身之中把它扬弃掉的时候才具有一的否定性，或者说，因为在自为存在的自身等同中，他在直接地无非是一个外在的界限，或者是一个并不算界限的界限。
带着这个无差别的界限的量就是量数。

en: Quantum is extensive quantum insofar as the limit refers to the moment of the multiplicity of quantity, or intensive quantum insofar as it refers to the moment of self-sameness or is posited in the determination of self-sameness.
zh: 量数是外延量数，就在于界限关联到量的众多环节，或者说，它是内含量数，就在于界限关联到自身等同的环节，或者处在自身等同的规定之中。

en: Since negativity is present on quantum as an indifferent limit, being-for-itself or the absolute determination is a beyond for it.
One can go beyond every quantum and set another limit, which is likewise no immanent limit.
There arises thereby the progress into infinity or bad infinity.
zh: 既然否定性作为无差别的界限就在量数上，那么自为存在或者绝对的规定对量数来说就是一个彼岸。
对每一个量数都可以越过去另设一个界限，而这个界限同样不是内在的界限。
这样就产生了向无限性的进展，或者说坏的无限性。

en: The absolute determination, which was posited as a beyond, is however, as being-for-itself, quantum's own moment.
Or the limit, which is no limit, is nothing other than the being-other sublated in being-for-itself.
It is the determinacy whose positing is self-determination; qualitative magnitude.
zh: 不过，那被设定为彼岸的绝对的规定，作为自为存在，正是量自己的环节。
或者说，那个并不算界限的界限，无非是在自为存在中被扬弃的他在。
它就是那种规定性，它的设定是自我规定；质的大小。

en: The qualitative magnitude is, as a simple determination, first of all a specific magnitude; as a self-determining being which differentiates itself, however, it is a specification of magnitudes which are at the same time determinate magnitudes in relation to one another and have a qualitative relation to one another, or whose quotient is their relational number and which, as qualitatively, are related to one another.
Since here the magnitudes are not only sublated as finite, but their being-sublated is itself posited as their qualitative law, this is their true, present infinity.
zh: 质的量作为简单的规定首先是特定的量，但作为自我区分的自我规定，却是量的一个具体化：这些量同时互为规定的量，彼此之间有质的关系，或者它们的商就是它们的比数，它们彼此是以质的方式相关的。
因为这里这些量不仅作为有限者被扬弃，而且它们被扬弃这一回事本身就被设定为它们的质的规律，所以这就是它们真正的、当前的无限性。

en: The simple interpenetration of the quantitative or external determination and of its own inner determining is the essence.
As the interpenetration of self-determination and of indifferent determinacy, it has within itself the moments of essentiality and inessentiality.
The essential is what belongs to self-determination, but the inessential is the moment of indifferent determinate being.
zh: 量的、外的规定与它自身的内在规定这两者的简单贯通，就是本质。
作为自我规定与无关的规定性的贯通，它自身带着本质性与非本质性这两个环节。
本质的东西是属于自我规定的东西，非本质的东西则是那无关的定在的环节。

en: Becoming, as the becoming of essence, is first of all the deed, a passing-over of essence into the freedom of determinate being, which is however a remaining-within-self.
zh: 生成，作为本质的生成，首先是行动，是本质过渡到定在的自由，而这个定在却是一种在自身内的停留。

en: Insofar as the deed is a difference of essence from itself and determinate being or determinacy is thereby brought about, the deed is positing.
zh: 就行动是本质相对于自身的一个差异、并且由此产生出定在或规定性而言，行动就是设定。

en: The proposition contains the moments of remaining-within-self or of self-equality and of pure distinguishing.
The former would be pure matter, the latter pure form.

Pure form, however, is the deed that remains within itself, and so the very same self-equality which was called pure matter, just as conversely this is the undifferentiated externality and is not distinguished from pure form.
zh: 命题包含在自身内的停留或与自身相等，以及纯粹的区分这两个环节。
前者是纯物质，后者是纯形式。
但纯形式就是在自身内停留的行动，也就是刚才被称为纯物质的那个自身相等；反过来，这物质就是无差别的外在性，与纯形式并没有区别。

en: The difference, however, must just as well be posited, and the unity of form and of self-equality, set against being-in-itself in the form of external determinate being, is what is commonly called matter.
Insofar as it is in the form of inward being, it is content; the form, however, is each of these determinations of difference.
zh: 但同样也必须设定这一差异，而形式与自身相等这个统一体，在与自在存在相对立、以外在定在的形式出现时，就是通常所谓的物质。
就它以内在存在的形式而言，它是内容，而形式则是差异的每一个这样的规定。

en: α) The simple proposition is the proposition of identity, a = a. It is indifferent to its matter.
Its content has no determination, or it has no content, and the form is thus the undifferentiated self-equality.
zh: α) 简单命题就是同一性命题，a = a。它与自己的物质无关。
它的内容没有任何规定，或者说它没有内容，于是形式就是无差别的自身相等。

en: β) The proposition of indifferent difference posits undetermined difference as such and says that there are no two things which are completely equal to one another.
zh: β) 无关的差异的命题一般地设定了不确定的差异，并且断言：不存在两个彼此完全相等的东西。

en: γ) The proposition of opposition is called: a is either b or -b, positivity and negativity.
Of the opposed predicates only the one belongs to things, and there is no third between them.
zh: γ) 对立的命题是：a 要么是 b，要么是 -b，肯定性与否定性。
在相对立的谓词中只有一个属于事物，而它们之间没有第三者。

en: δ) The principle of ground expresses the return into itself of what has been posited, or the positing itself as the third, in which the opposed determinations are sublated and which, as the simple one, is the determination opposed to the grounded, the grounded being the determinate being of manifoldness.
zh: δ) 根据命题所表达的是被设定者向自身的返回，或者说，是设定本身作为第三者，在其中相对立的规定被扬弃，而这个第三者作为单纯者，乃是与被根据者相对的规定，被根据者即是多样化的定在。

en: Whole and Parts
zh: 整体与部分

en: The essence as the ground of its determinate being, without which the essence itself is not, is in the first place whole and parts.
The whole is the positing of its parts and conversely consists of them.
Both sides make up one and the same.

The whole is equal to the parts only as their coming-together, i.e. as the whole, and the parts are equal to it as the divided, i.e. as parts; or both sides stand indifferent to one another, and the activity of the whole as form has matter for its condition.
zh: 本质作为自身定在的根据，没有它本质本身也就不是，首先是整体与部分。
整体是设定它的部分，反过来也由这些部分构成。
两个方面构成同一个东西。
整体只有作为它们的集合、也就是作为整体，才与部分相等；而部分只有作为被分开者、也就是作为部分，才与它相等；或者说，两方面彼此平列不分高下，而整体作为形式的活动以物质为条件。

en: Force and its Manifestation
zh: 力及其显现

en: The parts, however, are parts only as posited through the whole.
This relation of theirs is determinacy through the unity of the ground.
Or the quality of the determinate being is posited through the activity of the ground as form, and the matter of the appearance is its own content.
It is thus force which manifests itself.
zh: 但部分只有作为通过整体而设定的，才是部分。
它们的这种关系就是通过根据的统一性而来的规定性。
或者说，定在的质是通过作为形式的根据的活动而设定的，而现象的物质就是它自己的内容。
所以它就是自我显现的力。

en: Force is the self-positing of its determinate being as determinate quality.
With respect to the side on which the determinate being is still being-for-another or externality, it is at the same time free of the same and does not cease when this its appearance disappears.
On this side it indeed no longer has matter for its condition, the matter which is its content and to which it belongs immanently, but still has an activity which solicits it.
zh: 力就是把自己的定在设定为规定质的那种自我设定。
就定在那还属于为他者而存在、属于外在性的这一面来说，它同时又摆脱了外在性，并且并不因它的这个现象消失而随之消失。
在这一面，它固然不再以那作为自己内容、内在地属于自己的物质为条件，但还有一种召唤它去行动的活动。

en: The soliciting activity is itself force and must, in order to be solicited, be solicited.
Since the relation of the two activities upon one another is this mutual exchange of their determinations, each of them is the ground of the activity or the manifestation of the other.
Therewith the concept of ground has arisen, which is the ground of its own and of the other activity that excites this.
zh: 这种召唤的活动本身就是力，而它为了被召唤，就必须被召唤。
既然这两种活动彼此之间的相互关系就是它们各自规定的相互交换，那么它们每一个都是另一方活动或显现的根据。
这样，根据的概念就产生了，它是自身活动、也是那个激起这一活动的另一方活动的根据。

en: Inner and Outer
zh: 内在与外在

en: The essence is the ground of its determinate being as activity that excites itself, and there is in its determinate being nothing alien or nothing that would not be posited through the ground itself.
The essence and its determinate being are thus one and the same.
That one relates itself as inner to itself as outer, which is only the presentation of the inner.
zh: 本质是自己定在的根据，是那种激发自身的活动；在它的定在里没有异己的东西，也没有一样东西不是通过根据本身而设定的。
因此，本质和它的定在是同一个东西。
前者作为内在者对自身作为外在者，而这个外在者只是内在者的呈现。

en: The ground, as this relation, is the unconditioned, the inner, the unity of matter as the self-equality that rests and of form as the unity of opposition.
It presents itself in its determinate being as matter, in which its forces rest, and as opposition and play of the forces that rouse themselves and act against one another.
The essence has thereby become actuality.
zh: 根据作为这一关系，就是无条件者、就是内在者，就是物质（作为静止的自身相等者）与形式（作为对立者的统一者）这两者的统一。
它在它的定在里表现为物质（诸力在其中安息），又表现为那些自我激发、彼此对立地起作用的力量的对立与游戏。
本质由此成了现实性。

en: Actuality is the self-subsistent relation.
It has the moments of its appearance or of its determinate being, which is the relation to itself, and of its possibility as the being-in-itself or the essence of its determinate being.
The actual itself is the unity of its possibility and its determinate being.
zh: 现实性是那个自身独立的关系。
它有它的现象的诸环节，或者有它的定在的诸环节——这个定在就是它与自身的关系——还有它的可能性的诸环节，也就是它定在的自在存在或本质。
现实者本身就是其可能性与其定在的统一。

en: The actual is substance.

It is an essence which contains the determinations of its determinate being in itself as simple attributes and laws and posits the same as an existing play or as its accidents, whose sublation is not a vanishing of the substance but its return into itself.
zh: 现实者就是实体。
它是本质，把自己定在的各项规定作为单纯的属性与规律包含在自身之内，又把同样的规定设定为存在的游戏，或设定为它的偶性；而这些偶性的扬弃并不是实体的消失，而是实体向自身的返回。

en: Substance is the necessity of its accidents.

These, in their free determinate being, have the relation of their nature to an other as something inner and hidden in them, and seem to lose their self-subsistence through external contingency and a foreign power, which in truth is only the restoration of the whole, and the whole takes back into itself the separation that has been made in them.
zh: 实体是其偶性的必然性。
这些偶性在它们自由的定在中，把它们本性的对一个他者的关系当作内在于它们之中的、隐蔽的关系，并且似乎通过外在的偶然和一种外来力量失去了它们的自身独立性；但这在真理上不过是整体的恢复，而这个整体把在它们身上造成的那种分离重新收回到自身之中。

en: Substance enters into the relation of causality insofar as it presents itself in the opposition of necessity.

The freely acting absolute cause is the substance not only as that which moves, whose activity begins in itself, but also as that which has in itself the entire content which it produces and which receives determinate being as effect.
zh: 实体就它在必然性的对立中呈现自身而言，进入因果性的关系。
自由起作用的绝对原因就是实体：它不仅是那个发动者——其活动在自身之内开始——而且也在自身之中拥有它所生产的全部内容，这一内容作为效果获得定在。

en: This activity is therefore, according to the opposition between activity and what is produced, a passing over into the opposite, but with respect to content an identical passing over.
zh: 因此，这一活动就活动与被造成者的对立而言，是向对立者的过渡；但就内容而言，却是一个同一的过渡。

en: Substance is therefore, as cause, active only upon and in itself and stands only in reciprocal action with itself, or, that is, it is the universal.
zh: 因此，实体作为原因只在自身之上、只在自身之内起作用，并且只与自身处于相互作用之中；或者说，它就是普遍者。

133.zh: 第二部分 主观逻辑

en: The concept is the whole of the determinations, summed up into their simple unity.
zh: 概念是各项规定的整体，被概括到它们的单纯统一之中。

en: It has the moments of universality, particularity and singularity.
zh: 它有普遍性、特殊性和单个性三个环节。

en: Universality is its unity-in-itself within determinacy. – Particularity is the negative as simple determinacy, which is pervaded by universality, or it is the mark. – Individuality is the negative as pure negativity relating to itself.
zh: 一般性是它在规定中的自在统一。——特殊性是作为单纯规定的否定，这否定为一般性所贯穿，或者说，它就是标志。——个别性是作为纯粹自我相关的否定性的否定。

en: Individuality has, as the negativity relating to itself without determinacy, determinacy as an indifferent but not independent, rather sublated, determinate being in it as a property, and is subject.
zh: 个别性作为与自身相关的、无规定的否定性，把规定作为无所谓的、但不是独立的、而是扬弃了的定在作为属性具有在自身之内，并且是主体。

en: The judgment is the separation of the subject from its determinacy or particularity and the relation of the same to it, which is its predicate.
Subject and predicate behave toward one another as the individual and the particular or the universal, or also as the particular and the universal.
zh: 判断是主体与它的规定即特殊性之间的分离，以及主体与那作为它自己谓词的规定之间的关系。
主体与谓词相互之间表现为个别者与特殊者或普遍者，或者也表现为特殊者与普遍者。

en: The judgment at the same time expands the subject into universality and at the same time sets its limits.
The predicate thereby at the same time goes beyond the subject, and at the same time it is contained in the subject, or the predicate is at the same time particular and universal.
zh: 判断同时把主体扩展到一般性，同时又设定主体的界限。
谓词因此同时超出主体之外，同时又包含在主体之内，或者说，谓词同时既是特殊的又是一般的。

148.en: a. Quality of the judgment or determinacy of the predicate
148.zh: a. 判断的质或谓词的规定

en: Since the judgment is the relation of the predicate to the subject, 1. its content and expression is at first this: the individual is universal; affirmative judgment. – 2.
But the individual is not universal – negative judgment –, but particular. – 3.
The individual is not particular – infinite judgment –, by which all determinacy, also the universal sphere, and thus the predicate altogether, is sublated.
zh: 由于判断就是谓词对主体的关系，所以 1. 它最初的内容和表达就是这个：个别者是一般的；肯定判断。—— 2.
但个别者不是一般的——否定判断——而是特殊的。—— 3.
个别者不是特殊的——无限判断——通过这种判断，一切规定，连同一般领域，因而谓词整体，都被扬弃。

151.en: b. Quantity of the judgment or determinacy of the subject
151.zh: b. 判断的量或主体的规定

en: The infinite judgment contains the individual as the individual or as this one, and 1. there arises the judgment "This one is such and such"; singular judgment. – 2.

Since the predicate at the same time also says something universal of the subject, the judgment must sound thus: "Some are such and such"; particular judgment, in which the opposite judgment lies immediately: "Some are not such and such". – 3.
This indeterminacy is sublated through the judgment: "Everything is such and such"; universal judgment.
zh: 无限判断把个别者作为个别者、作为这一个包含在自身之内，于是 1. 产生了判断「这一个是这样的」；单称判断。—— 2.
由于谓词同时也就主体说出某个普遍的东西，判断必须这样表述：「有些是这样的」；特称判断，其中直接就含着相反的判断：「有些不是这样的」。—— 3.
这种不定性通过判断而扬弃：「一切是这样的」；全称判断。

154.en: c. Relation of the judgment or determinacy of the relation
154.zh: c. 判断的关系或关系的规定

en: Through the qualitative and the quantitative judgment, both subject and predicate have been posited in all the determinacies of the concept, the concept is thereby present in itself, and
zh: 通过质的判断和量的判断，主体与谓词都在概念的一切规定中被设定，概念由此自在地有了，而

en: the judgment now contains a relation of determinate being to the concept.
This proper judgment is 1. categorical.
But since that relation of the concept to determinate being is as yet only an inward connection, the categorical judgment is at the same time only assertive.
zh: 判断现在包含着定在者对概念的一种关系。
这种本真的判断是 1. 定言的。
但由于概念对定在的那种关系毕竟还只是一种内在的联系，定言判断同时就只是断言的。

en: The hypothetical judgment, "if a is, then b is", expresses the connection as such, thus without affirmation or assertion of determinate being, by which it is problematic.
zh: 假言判断「如果 a 是，那么 b 是」，把这种联系本身表达出来，而且是不带对定在的断定或断言，由此它才是有问题的。

en: The disjunctive judgment, "a is either b or c or d", contains in the predicate the universality and the particularity of the same.
The subject is related to these determinations just as much as a universal, as these exclude one another too and only one of them can belong to the subject.
This judgment is apodictic.
zh: 这个选言判断「a 或者是 b 或者是 c 或者是 d」，在谓词中包含着它的普遍性和特殊性。
主体同样作为普遍者与这些规定相关联，就像这些规定也彼此排斥、而主体只能得到其中之一那样。
这个判断是断言式的。

en: The syllogism is the presentation of the concept in its moments.
Individuality, particularity and universality are therein both distinguished as moments and the extremes are brought together through the middle, which is their unity.
zh: 推论是概念在其诸环节中的展现。
个别性、特殊性和普遍性在其中既作为环节彼此区分开来，两个极端又由中项——也就是它们的统一体——结合起来。

en: The syllogism is, 1., first of all the combining of individuality and universality through particularity as the middle.

The sense of this syllogism is: a) the individual is through its determinacy a universal or has determinate being at all; b) the individual has through its immediate determinacy yet another determinacy which comprehends that one within itself.
zh: 推论是：1. 首先，通过作为中项的特殊性，把个别性与普遍性结合起来。
这个推论的意思是：a) 个别者通过自己的规定性是一个普遍者，或者说它总归有定在；b) 个别者通过自己直接的规定性还有另一个规定性，后者把前者包含在自身之内。

en: The form of this syllogism, E - B - A2) , is the general rule of the subsumption of a determinate content under a universal determination.

If this one, as in identical propositions, is not more universal with respect to the content than the one of which it is immediately predicated, yet it has the form of universality as a predicate over against the other as subject.
zh: 这个推论的形式，E - B - A2)，是把一个规定的内容归摄到一条普遍规定之下的普遍规则。
就算这一条像在同一性命题中那样，就内容而言并不比它所直接谓述的那一条更普遍，它毕竟作为谓词相对于作为主体的另一条具有普遍性的形式。

en: In quantitative determinations the moments of the syllogism have no relation of form to one another, but the relation of equality.
The mathematical syllogism is therefore called: what is equal to a third thing is equal to one another.
zh: 在量的规定中，推论的诸环节彼此之间没有形式的关系，而是有相等的关系。
所以数学推论被称作：与第三者相等的东西，彼此相等。

en: Syllogisms, whatever position the moments contained in them may have, are to be reduced to the form indicated above, which is the general rule of all syllogisms.
zh: 无论推论中所包含的诸环节处在什么位置，各种推论都须归约到上面给出的形式上，而这个形式就是一切推论的普遍规则。

en: Considered in the syllogism according to its determinate moments, the middle is the particular, a determinacy whose plurality contains the individual as concrete within itself, which can therefore also be joined with other universal determinations that restrict one another and can even sublate one another. - Likewise the particular is relatable for itself to other universal determinations.
Conversely the universal comprehends other determinacies and thus also other individualities within itself.
Consequently the individual and the universal which are joined here are a contingent content for one another.
zh: 就推论按其规定的诸环节来看，中项就是特殊性，一种规定性，它的多重性把作为具体者的个别者包含在自身之内，因此这个个别者也能与其他那些彼此限制、甚至彼此扬弃的普遍规定结合起来。——同样，特殊者就其自身而言也可以关联到别的普遍规定。
反过来，普遍者把别的规定性、因而也把别的个别性包含在自身之内。
因此，在这里被结合起来的个别者与普遍者，对彼此来说只是一种偶然的内容。

en: With regard to the relation of the moments, there are in the syllogism two immediate relations or judgments, namely that of the individual to the particular and that of the particular to the universal, and one mediated relation: the syllogistic conclusion.

Because only the mediated relation contains the unity of those joined together and thereby, in terms of form, the necessity of their relation, the two immediate relations too must likewise be presented as mediations.
But if this is done through the same kind of syllogism, then there arises a progression into bad infinity, since every such interposed syllogism has the same defect.
zh: 就诸环节之间的关系来看，推论中有两个直接的关系或判断，即个别者对特殊者的关系和特殊者对普遍者的关系，还有一个经过中介的关系：推论句。
因为只有这个经过中介的关系才包含着被结合起来者的统一，并由此在形式上包含着它们之间关系的必然性，所以那两个直接的关系同样也必须被表述为中介。
可是，如果这是通过同一种推论来做的，那么就会出现向坏的无限进程的推进，因为每一个这样插入的推论都有同样的缺陷。

en: The immediate relations of the individual to the particular and of the particular to the universal must therefore first be mediated according to the general form of the syllogism as such, but through another determinacy of the middle term.

The second general syllogism is therefore that the particular is joined with the universal through the individual. - But the individual as a determinate being must, insofar as it is to be the middle term, be the totality: syllogism by induction.
Induction cannot become complete, because the determinate individual belongs to free contingency, and this syllogism therefore remains incomplete, as it also contains no inner necessity.
zh: 个别者对特殊者的直接关系，以及特殊者对普遍者的直接关系，因此首先必须按推论的一般形式本身来得到中介，不过这一中介是通过中项的另一种规定性而来的。
所以第二个普遍推论就是：特殊者通过个别者与普遍者结合在一起。——但个别者作为定在者，只要它要当中项，就必须是全体：通过归纳的推论。
归纳不可能成为完整的，因为定在的个别者属于自由的偶然性，所以这个推论仍然是不完整的，它也不包含任何内在的必然性。

en: Individuality, however, as the middle term, insofar as it is the universal moment of the concept, joins the particular and the universal together in a true manner.

It is the negative unity in which, as becoming and activity, the particularity as differentiated multiplicity and condition of determinate being has been gathered into one and raised to the simple universal unity, or conversely the universal has been individualized and has entered into the multiplicity of determinate being.
zh: 个别性作为中项，只要它是概念的普遍环节，就真正地把特殊者与普遍者结合在一起。
它是否定性统一，在其中，作为生成与活动，特殊性作为有差别的多样性和定在的条件被收拢为一，并被提升为单纯的一般统一，或者反过来，一般者被个别化并进入了定在的多样性之中。

en: Finally, the relation of individuality to particularity must be mediated, for which the universal is present: syllogism of analogy.

In this syllogism the middle term, as against the extreme of particularity, has the determination of individuality and splits into the individual and the universal, since what holds only of the individual is taken as universal.
This syllogism therefore really contains four determinations (quaternio terminorum) and is for that reason defective.
zh: 最后，个别性对特殊性的关系必须得到中介，而所需要的一般者已经在场：类比推论。
在这个推论中，中项相对于特殊者这一极端具有个别性的规定，并分解为个别者与普遍者，因为那只对个别者成立的东西被当作普遍有效的来看。
所以这个推论其实包含四个规定（quaternio terminorum），因此是有缺陷的。

en: Universality, however, as the true middle term, is the inner nature and the whole concept, in which the negative unity, the subjectivity as well as the objectivity, the content and the particularity of determinate being interpenetrate, and which is the absolute ground and connection of being-within-itself and determinate being.
zh: 普遍性作为真正的中项，则是内在的本性和整个概念，在这概念中，否定性统一、主体性以及客观性、定在的内容和特殊性相互渗透，而它就是自身内存在与定在的绝对根据和联系。

en: The first syllogism, E - B - A, the mediation of individuality and universality through particularity, presupposes the two following ones, through which its two immediate relations are mediated.
Conversely, however, these two presuppose each other and likewise the first.
The immediate requires mediation and comes forth from it alone, just as conversely mediation comes forth from the immediate.

Those syllogisms form a circle of mutual presupposition, which as a whole binds itself to itself and, in the simple mediation - which is just as immediate - gathers itself together into the centre point.
zh: 第一个推论，E - B - A，即个别性与普遍性通过特殊性的中介，预设了下面两个推论，它的两种直接关系就是通过它们得到中介的。
反过来，这两个推论又彼此预设，同时也预设第一个推论。
直接者要求中介，而且只从中介中产生出来；反过来，中介又是从直接者中产生出来的。
这些推论构成一个相互预设的圆圈，它作为整体把自己束缚于自身，并且在同样直接的那个单纯中介里，把自己收拢到中心点上。

en: This whole of the mediation that presupposes itself mutually - which is just thereby simple immediacy - brings forth a determinate being which has that cause and its activity as its presupposition, but conversely what is brought forth is just as much the ground of the activity and of the bringing forth itself.

This mediation is therefore neither a passing-over like the becoming of being as such, in which the passing-over loses itself in its opposite; nor is it a bringing forth like the appearing of the ground, which is only immediate, or the manifestation of the power, whose activity is conditioned; nor an efficacy like that of the cause, whose activity disappears in the effect.
zh: 这个相互自我预设的中介整体——它正因此就是单纯的直接性——产生出一个定在，它以那个原因及其活动为预设；但反过来，被产生出来的东西同样是活动以及产生活动本身的根据。
所以这个中介既不是一种过渡，像存在一般的那种生成那样，其中过渡者在它的对立面中丧失了自己；也不是一种产生，像根据的那种显现那样，那只是直接的，或者像力量的显现那样，其活动是有条件的；也不是一种作用，像原因的作用那样，其活动消失在效果之中。

en: A. Purpose, looked at more closely, is the real and self-realizing concept, as a whole as in its parts, the entire syllogism.

It is first, as the subjective, the whole syllogism, namely 1. the immediate, in-itself universal being, which 2. determines or particularizes itself and 3. drives itself to going out of itself, to determinate being.
zh: A. 目的再细看，就是那个实在的、自己实现自身的概念，无论是作为整体还是作为各部分，都是整个推论。
它首先作为主观者，是整个推论，也就是：1. 直接的、在自身的普遍者，它 2. 自行规定自己、把自己特殊化，3. 并驱使自己走向自身之外、走向定在。

en: B. The realization of the purpose is likewise the entire syllogism.

This mediation is 1. an active purpose as an acting cause, but 2. through a means which on the one hand belongs to the subjective and is brought by the activity into connection with the purpose, on the other hand belongs to determinate being or to objectivity and is brought by the activity into connection with this objectivity; 3. the activity works upon the immediate determinate being and, through its sublation, gives itself a mediated, produced objectivity.
zh: B. 目的的实现同样就是整个推论。
这一中介：1. 是作为起作用的原因而起作用的目的，但 2. 又是通过一个手段，这手段一方面属于主观方面，由活动把它同目的联系起来，另一方面属于定在或客观性，由活动把它同这一客观性联系起来；3. 活动作用于直接的定在，并通过扬弃这个定在而给自己造成一个被中介的、被产生出来的客观性。

en: C. This, the fulfilled purpose, represents the mediation through the universal.
It is something external which is on the one hand product, on the other hand ground of the bringing forth.

In it the effectual has thereby just as much gone out of itself and passed over into its opposite, as it has also returned into itself out of the mediating activity and in its other-being has found only itself.
zh: C. 这一个，即已成就的目的，表示出通过普遍者的中介。
它是一个外在的东西，一方面是产物，另一方面是产生的根据。
在其中，起作用的那个东西由此既同样地走出了自身而转入自己的对立面，也同样地从中介活动那里回到自身，并且在它的他在之中只找到了它自己。

en: Insofar as the purpose, as an active cause, lets means and product fall asunder in existence, so that the means does not have the purpose in itself and the product does not have the activity in itself, purposiveness is merely external; and it is relative in general, insofar as the purpose itself is given by a subordinate content and whatever is a means for it has this relation to it only in some one respect.
zh: 就目的作为起作用的原因而使手段与产物在存在中彼此分离而言，也就是说手段本身并不包含目的、产物本身并不包含作用于它的活动，合目的性就只是一种外在的合目的性；而且它总归是相对的，因为目的本身出自一个居次要的内容，而对它来说作为手段的那个东西，只是在某一个方面才同它有这一关系。

en: The purpose of the existent is that which it is in itself and in truth, or its concept.
The relative purposiveness, which has regard only to some one determinacy of the existent, therefore does not exhaust its concept.
zh: 存在者的目的就是它自在并且在真理上所是的东西，也就是它的概念。
这种相对合目的性只顾及存在者的某一项规定性，因此并没有穷尽它的概念。

en: Inner purposiveness is the one in which something is on its own account at once as much purpose as means, its own product, and this product the producing one itself.
A such is self-purpose.
zh: 内在的合目的性是这样一种合目的性：某物自在自身既是目的又是手段，是它自己的产物，而这个产物就是生产者本身。
这样的东西就是自目的。

en: The idea is the adequate concept in which objectivity and subjectivity are equal, or in which determinate being corresponds to the concept as such.
It contains within itself the true self-life.
The idea is partly life, partly recognizing, partly science.
zh: 观念是相应的概念，在其中客观性等于主观性，或者定在这一概念本身与概念相应。
它把真正的自我生命包含在自己之内。
观念一部分是生命，一部分是认识，一部分是科学。

en: Life is the idea in the element of determinate being.

Through the unity of the concept and of objectivity the living being is such a whole in which the parts are nothing for themselves, but are only through the whole and in the whole, organic parts in which matter and form are an inseparable unity.
zh: 生命是处在定在这一元素中的观念。
凭概念与客观性的统一，有生命的东西是这样的一个整体：其中各个部分不是为自己而存在，而是只有通过整体并且在整体之中才存在，是有机的部分，其中物质与形式是不可分离的统一。

en: Life has in itself the general moments which constitute just so many general organic systems: 1. its general simple being-in-itself in its externality, sensibility; 2. the excitability from without and the immediate reaction against it, irritability; 3.
the return of this action outward into itself, reproduction.
zh: 生命自身带着那些一般环节，它们构成同样多的普遍的有机体系统：1. 它在外在性中自身内的单纯普遍存在，感受性；2. 来自外部的可刺激性以及对它的直接反作用，应激性；3.
这一作用从外面回复到自身，生殖。

en: As a self-movement that realizes itself, life is the threefold process: 1. the shaping of the individual within itself, 2. its self-preservation against its inorganic nature, 3. the preservation of the species.
zh: 作为实现自身的自我运动，生命是三重过程：1. 个体在自身之中的形态生成，2. 个体针对其无机自然的自我保存，3. 属的保存。

en: The process of shaping is the relation of the organic to itself and consists in the fact that all organic parts continually produce one another and the preservation of the one depends on the preservation of the rest.
This production is on the one hand only the evolution of the organization present in itself, on the other hand the continual alteration of the same.
That mere growth or quantitative alteration, however, is a process of multiplication through intussusception, not through juxtaposition, that is, not a mechanical multiplication.
zh: 形态生成的过程就是有机的自我关系，在于所有有机的部分持续不断地相互产生，而其中一部分的保存依赖于其余部分的保存。
这种产生一方面只是自在已有的组织的展开，另一方面则是这一组织持续不断的变化。
但那种单纯的生长或量的变化，是靠内摄而非靠并置的增殖过程，也就是说，不是一种机械的增殖。

en: The process of organic alteration is just as little a chemical process.

In the chemical, the materials that stand in relation to one another are indeed related to each other through their concept (chemical affinity) and thus contain in themselves their product, which is not already produced through what was previously there and equal to it.
Its production, however, is no self-preservation.

It is therefore only a neutral product, that is, a product in which the activity that pertains only to the separated materials is extinguished, does not itself produce, and can again be separated into its components according to quality and quantity.
zh: 有机变化的过程同样不是化学过程。
在化学反应中，彼此发生关系的物质确实通过它们的概念而相互关联（化学转化力），因而自在地包含着它们的产物；这产物并不是通过先在的、与它相同的东西产生出来的。
但它的产生并不是自我保存。
所以它只是一种中性的产物，也就是说，在这种产物里，那种只属于彼此分离的诸物质的活動消失了，它本身并不生产，并且还能按质与量重新分成它的各个组成部分。

en: The organic process of nutrition, by contrast, is a complete determination of the material multiplication through the form that already exists within, which, as the subjective or as the simple form of all parts, relates to itself, or each part relates to the remaining parts as to something objective, and is only with itself in the process.
zh: 相反，有机的营养过程则是通过内部已经存在的形式，对物质的增殖作完全的规定；这一形式作为主观的、作为所有部分的单纯形式与自身相关，或者每一部分把其余各部分当作客观的来对待，并且在过程中只同自己在一起。

en: The self-preservation process of the organic against its inorganic nature. - The free opposition of life into subjective and objective presents itself as organic and inorganic nature.

The latter is life without individuality, in which the individual exists for itself, has its concept only as the law of natural necessity, not in subjective form in it, and its meaning falls only into the whole.
This whole, as subject, is the organic, to which the inorganic nature essentially relates and of which it constitutes the condition.
zh: 有机的自我保存过程，针对其无机自然。——生命分为主观与客观的自由对立，呈现为有机的自然与无机的自然。
后者是没有个体性的生命，其中单个者为自己而存在，它只在自然必然性的规律这一形式下具有自己的概念，而不是以主观的形式在自身中具有它，并且它的意义只落到整体之中。
这个整体作为主体就是有机的，无机自然本质上以它为依据，并构成它的条件。

en: The inorganic condition does not relate to the organic as cause or as chemical moment, but what is posited in the organic through the action of the inorganic is essentially determined by the organic itself and acts only as an exciter.

The organic is the twofold movement of the continual struggle which on the one side arrests the elemental becoming and the passage into the opposite, sublates its condition and individualizes the objective universality, but on the other side dissolves the individual or the subjective out of itself and lowers it to inorganic determinate being.
zh: 无机条件并不是作为原因、也不是作为化学的环节与有机的相关，而是：有机之中通过无机的作用所设定的东西，其本质上由有机自身决定，它只作为激发者起作用。
有机的乃是持续斗争的双重运动：这一斗争一面阻止初步的生成与向对立面的过渡，扬弃它的条件，使客观的普遍性个体化；但另一方面又从自身中溶解出个体者或主观者，并把它降低为无机的定在。

en: The process of the preservation of the species is a) the realization of the species as such, which as universal life passes over into actuality in the individual, into individuality, through the differentiation of the kind, b) the relation of the organic to the organic equal to it, through which it produces itself as another individual of the same species, which presents itself in this alternation of the individuals and in the return of singleness to universality.
zh: 属的保存过程是：a) 属本身得以实现，它作为普遍的生命通过种的分化在单个者中、在个体性上过渡到现实性；b) 有机的与那个同它一样的有机的之间的关系，它由此把自己产生为同一属的另一个个体，而这个属就在个体的这种更替以及单个性向普遍性的回返中呈现出来。

en: Knowing is the presentation of an object according to its determinate determinations, as these are comprehended in the unity of its concept and result from it, or conversely insofar as the concept's own efficacy gives itself its determinations.
These determinations, posited as contained in the concept, are knowing, or the idea realizing itself in the element of thinking.
zh: 认识就是按照一个对象的定在规定来呈现它，这些规定被包含在它的概念的统一性中并由此得出，或者反过来说，就概念自身的效力以此给自己以规定而言。
这些规定被设定为包含在概念之中，它们就是认识，或者说，就是在思维元素中实现自身的观念。

en: Absolute knowing has 1. nothing external, given in some way or other, for its object, but only itself.
It is the concept existing as concept.
The concept constructs itself out of itself, in that it is becoming and presents the opposition contained in it in the form of various real or intellectual determinations existing on their own.

In that the real determinations first in their reflection become determinations of understanding, their dialectic presents them not only as essentially referring to one another but also as passing over into their unity.
Out of this negative movement of theirs there results their positive unity, and this unity is the concept in its real totality.
zh: 绝对知识有 1. 没有任何外在的、以任何方式给定的东西作为自己的对象，而只有它自己。
它就是作为概念而存在的概念。
概念从自身构造自身，因为它是生成，并把其中所包含的对立以各种各自独立存在的实在规定或知性规定的形式表现出来。
由于实在的规定首先在它们的反思中成为知性的规定，它们的辩证法就不但把它们表现为本质上彼此相关，而且把它们表现为过渡到它们的统一。
由它们这一否定性的运动产生出它们的肯定性统一，而这统一正是概念在其实在的总体性。

229.zh: 第二部分　自然的科学

en: Nature is the absolute idea in the shape of other-being as such, of the indifferent, external objectivity, and of the concrete, individualised realisation of its moments, — or the absolute essence in the determination of immediacy as such over against its mediation.
The becoming of nature is the becoming towards spirit.
zh: 自然是在他者存在这一一般形态、无所谓的外在客观性、以及其诸环节的具体个别化实现这种形态里的绝对观念，——或者说，是在一般直接性这一规定中与其中介相对而立的绝对本质。
自然的生成就是朝向精神的生成。

en: Nature is to be considered as a system of stages, of which one emerges necessarily out of the other, but not in such a way that one is produced by the other naturally, but in the inner idea that underlies nature.
The movement of the idea of nature is to go out of its immediacy in itself, to sublate itself and to become spirit.
zh: 自然应当看作一个诸阶段的体系，其中一个阶段必然地从另一个阶段产生出来，但并不是一个阶段由另一个阶段自然地产生出来，而是在那作为自然之基础的内在的观念中。
自然的观念的运动就是：从自身的直接性中走出来，扬弃自身，并成为精神。

en: Natural science considers 1. the ideal determinate being of nature as space and time as such, 2. the inorganic, 3. the organic nature, and is accordingly 1.
mathematics, 2.
physics of the inorganic, 3.
the science of organic nature.
zh: 自然科学考察 1. 自然的观念的定在，即空间与时间这一一般形态，2. 无机自然，3. 有机自然，因而就是 1。
数学，2。
无机物的物理学，3。
有机自然的科学。

en: Space and time are the abstractions that are determinate being, or pure form, pure intuition of nature, — space the thought in determinate being of the general indifferent difference as such, time the thought in determinate being of negative unity or of pure becoming.
zh: 空间和时间是处在定在中的抽象，或者说，是纯粹的形式、自然的纯粹直观，——空间是一般无所谓的多样性处在定在中的思想，时间是否定性统一或纯粹生成处在定在中的思想。

en: Space and time are infinite, that is, boundless in the abstract continuity of their being-outside-themselves.
As ideas, however, they have determinations in themselves which represent the concept in its moments: the dimensions.
zh: 空间和时间是无限的，也就是说，在它们自身之外的抽象连续性中是无边的。
但作为观念，它们自身带有一些规定，这些规定在其诸环节中表现出概念：即诸维度。

en: The dimensions of space are moments of the same, which are not outside one another, but where the one is, each of the others is also.
They are indeed the formal differences, the one, the other and the third, as unity of the same.

But for the sake of the qualityless unity of space they are not determined in relation to one another, but empty differences, which only with regard to another object acquire a determinacy foreign to themselves.
zh: 空间的诸维度是同一个东西的诸环节，它们并不互相外在，而是在这一个所在的地方，其他每一个也在那里。
它们固然是形式上的差别，即这一个、那一个和第三个，都是同一个东西的统一。
但由于空间那无质的统一之故，它们彼此之间并没有被规定，而是空的差别；这些差别只有就另一个对象而言，才获得一种对它们自身而言陌生的规定性。

en: The dimensions of time are a) the past, determinate being as sublated, as not existing, b) the future, non-determinacy, but determined to be there, c) the present as the immediate becoming and the union of both.
zh: 时间的诸维度是：a) 过去，定在，作为扬弃了的定在，作为不再定在；b) 将来，非定在，但被规定为将要定在；c) 当下，作为直接的生成以及两者的统一。

en: Because space is in the determinacy of a real, indifferent determinate being, real boundaries also appear on it, and its dimensions, which to begin with are nothing but mere directions as such, make up the forms of this its limitation.
zh: 因为空间处在一种实在的、无关的定在的规定之中，所以实在的界限也出现在它上面；而它的诸维度——起初不过是单纯的方向而已——构成这种对它的界限的诸形式。

en: Only the indifferent determinacy of quantity pertains to the limitation of space.
Continuous magnitude, which to begin with is the mode of its quantity as such, is itself an indeterminate determinacy.
Absolute determinacy lies in the discrete magnitude, whose principle is the One.
zh: 归于空间的界限的，只是量的无关的规定性。
连续量——它起初是空间在一般情况下的量的方式——本身就是一种不确定的规定性。
绝对的规定性在离散量之中，离散量的原则是“一”。

en: Space is the object of a (synthetic) science, geometry, because in it as such continuous magnitude can be schematized, that is, represented intuitively, and because in it, as the element of an indifferent manifold which is external to itself but is at the same time continuous, the concept of an object expresses itself in a real form which contains more within itself than the essential determinacy of the concept.
zh: 空间是一门（综合的）科学即几何学的对象，因为在空间本身之中，连续的量能够获得图式化，即能够以直观的方式呈现出来；又因为在空间中——作为无关的、彼此外在的、同时又连续的多样性的要素——一个对象的概念以实在的形式表达出来，这种形式在自身中所包含的，比概念的本质规定性更多。

en: Time, however, as such is not capable of being a complete schema or figure of magnitude.
As the unquiet becoming, it is not an element for synthetic wholes.

Insofar as it becomes quantity, it passes over into the negative determinacy of quantity, into the One, which is the principle of a (analytic) science of magnitude, arithmetic, because the combination of the One is not a peculiar elementary intuition of reality but is rather such as it is posited.
zh: 然而时间本身不能成为量的完整的图式或图形。
作为不息的生成，它不是综合整体的要素。
当它成为量的时候，它就转入负的量的规定性、转入“一”；而“一”是量的一门（分析的）科学即算术学的原则，因为“一”的结合并不是对实在性的一种特有的基本直观，而是像它被设定的那样。

en: In arithmetic and geometry magnitudes are compared with one another, which, however arbitrary and general their size may be, still hold as perfect or determinate-in-themselves magnitudes, as finite magnitudes, according to that determinacy which accrues to them insofar as they are not in a ratio.

The analysis of the infinite, but above all the differential and integral calculus, considers infinite magnitudes, that is, such as no longer have the meaning of finite magnitudes or of magnitudes perfect and determinate in themselves, but are vanishing magnitudes, which alone have their value purely in their last ratio or at their limit, that is, purely in relation.
zh: 在算术学和几何学中，各个量彼此互相比较；这些量无论其大小可以多么任意、多么一般，按照那种在它们彼此之间并非处于比例关系时这才归到它们身上的规定性，仍然作为完满的或自为规定了的量、作为有限的量而有效。
对无穷的分析，尤其是微分与积分的计算，则考察无穷的量，也就是那些不再具有有限的量或自为完满地规定了的量之意义的量，而是消失的量；这种量仅仅在它们最后的比例中、在它们的界限处，也就是纯粹只在比例关系中，才具有其值。

en: The differential calculus finds for a formula the expression of the last ratio of its variable, finite magnitudes.
The integral calculus conversely seeks for formulas which contain last ratios the finite expression.
zh: 微分计算为一个公式找出其可变的、有限的诸量的最后比例的表达。
积分计算反过来为那些包含最后比例的公式求出有限的表达。

en: Applied mathematics applies pure mathematics to the magnitude-relations of nature, which it takes up from experience.
zh: 应用数学把纯粹数学应用于自然的大小关系，这些关系它是从经验中取得的。
